newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta, India in air services agreement.
newsitem.headline: Malta, India in air services agreement.

text.p: Malta and India on Monday reached an air services agreement allowing Air Malta and Air India to operate scheduled flights between the two countries without any restrictions on the type of aircraft.

The Malta Department of Information said Air Malta can operate up to two weekly flights to Bombay or New Delhi. It said the agreement was part of the transport ministry's plan for communications between Malta and the Far East.
Passenger traffic between Malta and India is negligible, but Air Malta is considering a service to the Far East and Australia, particularly Melbourne and Sydney, which have large Maltese communities.
An air services agreement with Australia was signed in September, allowing Air Malta to fly two flights per week to Melbourne and Sydney via India or Singapore.
